title: nan
authors: Cvišić I.; Ćesić J.; Marković I.; Petrović I.
key_contribution: Presents SOFT-SLAM, a computationally efficient stereo visual SLAM algorithm combining stereo feature-tracking odometry (SOFT) with pose graph optimization for autonomous UAV inspection.
